name: so.naut/naut
title: NAUT
description: Directory of the people building in crypto and how to reach them: Telegram, email, LinkedIn, X.

tools.name: naut_me
tools.description: Your identity, plan, credit balance, and every NAUT endpoint with its price. Free. Use this when the user asks about their NAUT account, plan or credits.

tools.name: naut_search
tools.description: One query across projects and people. Costs 5 credits. Use this when the user names a project or person and you need to find it, or its id or slug.

q.description: Name, handle, domain or job title to look for.

tools.name: naut_search_projects
tools.description: Search and filter crypto projects. Supports q, sector, token (launched or pre), sort (recent or name), page, limit. Costs 5 credits. Use this when the user wants a list of crypto projects, for example by sector or token status.

q.description: Text to match against names, handles and domains.

sector.description: Only projects in any of these sectors.

token.description: launched = has a token, pre = no token yet.

tools.name: naut_get_project
tools.description: One project with its team. Accepts an id or a slug. Costs 5 credits. Use this when the user wants one project's details or team and you have its id or slug.

tools.name: naut_search_people
tools.description: Search and filter people. Supports q, roles, channels, contactType, sort. Costs 5 credits. Use this when the user wants a list of people, for example founders, or people with a Telegram or email.

q.description: Text to match against names, handles and job titles.

channels.description: Comma-separated channels the person must have: twitter,telegram,email,phone.

tools.name: naut_get_person
tools.description: One person, their companies, and their coworkers. Accepts an id or a slug. Costs 5 credits. Use this when the user wants one person's profile, companies or coworkers and you have their id or slug.

tools.name: naut_reveal_contact
tools.description: Reveal a person's telegram, email, phone and LinkedIn. A permanent unlock: later calls on the same person cost the basic rate. Needs the read:contacts scope. Costs 10 credits the first time, then 5. Use this when the user asks for a person's contact details and is happy to spend the credits.

tools.name: naut_search_investors
tools.description: Search and filter funds. Supports q, fundType, trustTier, sort. Costs 5 credits. Use this when the user wants a list of investors or funds, for example by fund type.

q.description: Text to match against names, handles and domains.

tools.name: naut_get_investor
tools.description: One fund with its team and portfolio. Costs 5 credits. Use this when the user wants one fund's details, team or portfolio and you have its slug or id.

tools.name: naut_search_services
tools.description: Search and filter service providers. Costs 5 credits. Use this when the user wants service providers such as auditors, legal, KYC, dev shops or agencies.

q.description: Text to match against names, handles and domains.

tools.name: naut_get_service
tools.description: One service provider with its team. Costs 5 credits. Use this when the user wants one service provider's details or team and you have its slug or id.
